en.headline: Civil service pensions rise 2.1 per cent under adjustment mechanism
en.dek: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said the increase adds about HK$370 a month on average, with new retirees averaging HK$20,200 monthly.
body: Secretary for the Civil Service Ingrid Yeung said civil service and judicial pensions rose 2.1 per cent in the last fiscal year under the established adjustment mechanism, resulting in an average additional payment of about HK$370 a month per person.

In a written reply to a lawmaker, Yeung said those who retired during the last fiscal year received an average monthly pension of about HK$20,200, while those who had already retired earlier received an average of about HK$17,700.

The statutory pension liability stood at HK$924.8 billion as of 31 March 2025, with roughly 40 per cent attributable to serving personnel and 60 per cent to those already retired. The pension scheme applies only to appointments before 1 June 2000. Yeung said expenditure is expected to continue rising for a period as remaining scheme members retire, then gradually decline from the mid-2030s.

zh.headline: 公務員退休金按機制增2.1%　平均每月多約370元
zh.dek: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵指，調整後平均每人每月額外支付約370元，上年度退休人員平均每月退休金約2.02萬元。
body: 公務員事務局局長楊何蓓茵表示，根據既定退休金調整機制，上一個財政年度退休金增加2.1%，當局每月向退休公務員及司法人員額外支付平均每人約370元退休金。
楊何蓓茵書面答覆議員質詢時指，上年度內退休的公務員及司法人員，平均每人每月退休金約2.02萬元；而於相關年度前已退休的，平均每人每月約1.77萬元。
截至2025年3月31日，法定退休金承擔額為9248億元，其中在職人員佔約四成，已退休人員占約六成。公務員退休金計劃只適用於2000年6月1日之前受聘的公務員。楊何蓓茵指，退休金支出會因應計劃下人員陸續退休而持續增加一段時間，預計到2030年代中期以後逐步減少。
